description: This Java class 'ReportService' provides reporting functionalities for the application, including retrieving all defects and generating PDF reports for individual defects with their corrective actions. It interacts with defect and corrective action repositories and formats the data into a PDF document using the iText library.

classes.name: ReportService
classes.description: A service component responsible for generating defect reports and exporting them as PDFs within the application.

methods.name: allDefects
methods.description: Retrieves all defects from the repository for reporting purposes.

methods.name: defectReportPdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF report for a specific defect, including its details and associated corrective actions.
